description: NaBaIrH₆ crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. The structure consists of four Na clusters inside a BaIrH₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the BaIrH₆ framework, Ba is bonded to twelve equivalent H atoms to form BaH₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent BaH₁₂ cuboctahedra and faces with four equivalent IrH₆ octahedra. All Ba-H bond lengths are 2.79 Å. Ir is bonded to six equivalent H atoms to form IrH₆ octahedra that share faces with four equivalent BaH₁₂ cuboctahedra. All Ir-H bond lengths are 1.69 Å. H is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two equivalent Ba and one Ir atom.
